The '''Brennkeyes Syndicate''' remained one of the most wanted criminal manufacturing groups in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It survived by constantly relocating and maintaining strict secrecy around its production methods. The quality and ingenuity of its products were exceptional, but their illegality drove prices even higher, making them rare and expensive on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brennkeyes Syndicate was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
